summary: 6 nimmt! (Take 5) is a simple, cutthroat card game where players simultaneously play numbered cards into rows, trying to avoid being the one who takes a row full of penalty 'bull head' points. It's quick, laugh-out-loud mean, and scales well to large groups.
praised: Extremely easy to teach and quick to play
Good mix of prediction and luck
criticised: Can feel repetitive over many rounds
Little you can do about a bad hand

interaction.kind: simultaneous card placement and penalty avoidance
interaction.detail: All players reveal cards simultaneously onto shared rows, and where your card lands depends entirely on everyone else's plays, often forcing you to take a bad row because of others' choices. The row state is fully shared and constantly reshaped by every player's card each turn.

scoring.why: Players accumulate bull-head penalty points from taken rows, and the game ends when someone crosses a threshold.
scoring.how_you_win: You win by having the fewest penalty points when another player crosses the losing threshold, achieved by avoiding taking full rows.
